title: Kagamine Len — Happy Anniversary! 2025〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Len and Rin's anniversary
Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Alright.
The coast is clear, you two.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Woohoo, we're on Vivid Street! Thanks for bringing us here, guys!>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You're welcome!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Still, are you sure this is how you want us to celebrate your anniversary?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I mean, we can take you to shows on Vivid Street anytime.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <This is totally it! Right, Rin?>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Yeah!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <We heard all the venues around here are absolutely on fire since RAD BLAST, so we've been wanting to go see!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Plus, we could get some inspiration for the events we put on!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Well... Guess it's fine, if that's what you guys want.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Haha, yeah!
Okay, let's hurry up and head over.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Right! We actually picked out some promising events yesterday.
Um, first up was...
Live House

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Whoa, awesome! Everybody's jumping all over the place!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Now I'm kinda itching to move too!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You are? I'm glad to see you both enjoying yourselves.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Hm. Hey, so I just had this thought...>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? What's up?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <With everyone going this crazy, don't you figure we could yell and nobody would realize?!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Oh, you're right! I bet we could join in the cheering right now!>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Huh?
W-Wouldn't somebody notice...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hey, couldn't hurt to try, right...?
Nobody's looking this way right now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah!
We're the furthest back, so we can explain it away somehow if we have to!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yes! Let's go, Rin!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Yeah!>

rows.Speaker: Musician
rows.Line: You guys ready to bring the hype?!

rows.Speaker: Len & Rin
rows.Line: <Yeah!!!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yes...! Nobody caught on!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Woohoo! We totally did it!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Hehe, shouting out loud definitely makes a show more fun!>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
That was a great event, huh! Everybody was super into it!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But... The day's not even close to over! We're gonna keep hitting up these live houses back to back!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Woo!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Whoa! This team's vocals really give you goosebumps!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I seem to recall that they're already working with a major label.
I'm a little surprised that they're doing another event in this neighborhood.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Wow...! Alright, let's try that singing style later!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yeah! Gotta make sure it sticks in our heads!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Hahaha! This MC is hilarious!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Right?! I can't believe this is the same person who was just singing!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Oh, hey, Len! Why don't we try doing some funny MCing too?!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Huh, you wanna try? Hmm... I guess our first step would be to ask Luka for help...>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe, she does seem like she'd be a really fun MC!

rows.Speaker: Len & Rin
rows.Line: <Man, that was great!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Spending our whole anniversary going to shows was just the best! Thanks, guys!>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe, you're welcome!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Still... At every live house we went to, the heat was just as intense as you guys said.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <And you guys putting on RAD BLAST was the trigger.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Looking at it that way, I can't help but feel a little bit of pride!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Why're you talking like you shouldn't be proud?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
He's right.
You all contributed to the heat we brought in that event.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Huh?>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, definitely! We couldn't have put on RAD BLAST without all the help we got from you two! Right, Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Right.
You two gave us so much. You practiced with us, and cheered us up when we felt like we might break.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Indeed. You looking after and supporting us led to the heat you felt in this neighborhood today.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Allow us to thank you again.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <You guys...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Hehehe! You're welcome!>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, we should get ready to see the next show soon!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Huh? After all those shows we saw, there's still another one?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
There is. This next one...
It's your show, Rin, Len.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Wait, ours...?!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Well, not you guys exactly. It's a show starring the VIRTUAL SINGERS Rin and Len from our world.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <The us from your world, putting on a show...! No way, that sounds awesome!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Yeah! I wanna see!>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That settles that! Let's watch it together at MEIKO's cafe where we can relax!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: C'mon, time for a trip to SEKAI!

rows.Speaker: Len & Rin
rows.Line: <Woo!>
